description: Issue #1475: the shared corpus for the canonical plan digest defined in docs/contracts/advisor-plan-digest.md. Both @clossys/advisor and @clossys/launcher test their own implementation against every case here, so the two packages compute identical digests. Expected values were produced independently of either package. The plans that carry kits, staffing, packages, resolution or a decision's subjectDigest (issue #1178) were added later and computed the same way, independently of either package: a stand-alone Python 3 script took each plan without asOf and decisions, serialized it with json.dumps(subject, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')) -- which is RFC 8785 for these plans, because every key is ASCII (so code-point order equals UTF-16 order) and the only number is the integer 1 -- and hashed its UTF-8 bytes with hashlib.sha256.

canonicalJson.name: keys-sort-by-utf16-code-units
canonicalJson.note: U+1F600 is the surrogate pair D83D DE00 in UTF-16, which sorts before U+FF61; code-point order would put U+FF61 first.

canonicalJson.name: numbers
canonicalJson.note: Numbers use ECMAScript Number.prototype.toString, and -0 is written 0. The plan contract itself admits only one number, schemaVersion 1.
